title: manifest-provenance
universal_lens: The Six-Stage Claim-Matrix establishes a rigorous bi-temporal isomorphism between abstract mathematical operators and physical data artifacts. By enforcing strict Merkle locks and cryptographic receipts, the framework guarantees that every state transition in the sports intelligence manifold is deterministically traceable, fail-closed, and immune to synthetic calibration drift.
gsi_mapping: GSI utilizes the claim-matrix to enforce conformal prediction boundaries over Bayesian posterior updates. Real-world parquet manifests act as hard priors, while OpenTimestamps pre-kickoff proofs ensure temporal consistency, preventing lookahead bias and guaranteeing that all probabilistic inferences are anchored to immutable, non-synthetic historical states.
gse_mapping: In GSE, situational reasoning is mapped to deterministic AST implementations verified against exact Git SHAs. The `MindGuardian` single-writer constraint ensures that state transitions within the multi-agent fleet are strictly causal, rejecting unverified chatter and maintaining a pristine, auditable game-state evolution.

reasoning_traces.think:
The Six-Stage Claim-Matrix functions as a high-dimensional verification manifold, mapping raw empirical observations into a rigorously constrained state space utilized by Galaxy Sports Intelligence (GSI) and Galaxy Sports Engine (GSE). At its core, the matrix enforces a strict duality between abstract mathematical operators and their concrete computational instantiations. Stage 3 (`code`) demands an isomorphic mapping between a theoretical operator and a verified Abstract Syntax Tree (AST), ensuring that the deployed algorithm precisely matches the intended quantitative logic without semantic leakage. This is immediately followed by Stage 4 (`test`), which applies deterministic boundary checks to validate the operator's behavior under controlled conditions.

However, the true epistemic strength of the doctrine emerges in Stages 5 and 6. Stage 5 (`real_data_manifest`) introduces a hard physical grounding mechanism. By requiring SHA-256 digests and explicitly rejecting synthetic calibration (`is_synthetic: false`), the system prevents the model from drifting into hallucinated parameter spaces. It enforces a Stage 0 Merkle lock, effectively freezing the foundational truth set before any dynamic inference occurs. Finally, Stage 6 (`receipt`) closes the loop with bi-temporal governance. Utilizing OpenTimestamps and a single-writer `MindGuardian`, it creates an immutable, causally ordered ledger of all state transitions. This ensures that any probabilistic update or situational reasoning step can be retroactively audited to its exact physical and temporal origin, completely eliminating lookahead bias and unauthorized state mutations.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This doctrine inherits deeply from the foundations of reproducible research and formal verification in computer science. Historically, it mirrors the evolution from simple unit testing to comprehensive continuous integration pipelines, but elevates these concepts through the lens of cryptographic accountability. The use of Merkle trees and content-addressable storage echoes distributed ledger technologies, adapted here for high-frequency sports analytics. Furthermore, the explicit rejection of synthetic data aligns with rigorous statistical practices demanding ground-truth anchoring, preventing the 'garbage in, gospel out' fallacy common in modern AI systems.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: In the context of multi-agent orchestration, this matrix acts as a shared cognitive protocol. Opposing agents or external scrapers attempting to inject noise or manipulate the system are immediately neutralized by the tier-based governance (rejecting Tier 5-6 chatter). The `MindGuardian` represents a centralized theory-of-mind anchor, assuming that only verified, cryptographically signed actions constitute valid knowledge updates. It models the environment not as a fluid stream of opinions, but as a rigid sequence of provable events, forcing all participating agents to adhere to the same strict evidentiary standards.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: The primary veto condition arises from anti-collinearity between the abstract operator and the physical manifest. If the AST implementation (Stage 3) suggests a complex non-linear transformation, but the real data manifest (Stage 5) lacks the necessary dimensional depth or exhibits synthetic markers, the pipeline must fail closed. Additionally, temporal leakage is strictly vetted; if an OpenTimestamps proof in the receipt (Stage 6) indicates data access prior to the allowed window (pre-kickoff `< T-5m`), the entire inference chain is invalidated. This cross-layer friction ensures that no single compromised stage can propagate falsehoods into the sovereign primitive layer.
